data.one_liner: Feature voting board and feedback collection widget for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a built-in feature voting board UI where users can upvote items, suggest new features, and leave feedback. It supports user identification, localizations, custom theming, and collecting device/app metadata.
use_when: You want to collect user feature requests and feedback inside your Flutter application
You need a ready-made roadmap and feature voting board UI
avoid_when: You require a custom-built feedback interface from scratch
You do not use the UserOrient backend service
strengths: Easy two-line setup and board launching
Supports multiple languages and light/dark theme customization
Allows user identification and tracking of paying customers
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the UserOrient service and dashboard
Limited offline functionality since it talks to a remote backend
data.setup_notes: Requires an API key from the UserOrient dashboard and initialization in main().
